args.title: Juniper Labware Newsletter Summary – Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter (Juniper Labware, "Freight pricing this quarter"): Highlights that spot freight rates fell, contract rates are holding, and fuel surcharges are being tied to weekly diesel prices.
- Linked article (blog.juniper.example/2026/freight): Expands on this — spot rates down 9%, contract rates stable, and surcharges now updated weekly against diesel benchmarks instead of a fixed schedule.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/freight/companion): Finds that shippers who split their volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
